rule.title: Amortizable bond premium is a Schedule A line 16 deduction only as a carryforward or on a pre-October 23, 1986 bond

citation.wording: A deduction for amortizable bond premium (for example, a deduction allowed for a bond premium carryforward or a deduction for amortizable bond premium on bonds acquired before October 23, 1986).

rule.open_point: The offset against the bond's interest is the Schedule B 'ABP Adjustment' the preparer's software figures; the excluded figure is not moved there.
